announcements.headline: Precise Biometrics: Shaping the new business
announcements.insight: The merger is complete. A rights issue information document was published in July, followed by a new share count in August.

announcements.headline: New number of shares and votes in Precise Biometrics
announcements.insight: Precise Biometrics AB updates share counts following the completed merger with Fingerprint Cards and a subsequent rights issue information document. Shareholders should monitor these structural changes.

announcements.headline: Precise Biometrics publishes information document regarding rights issue
announcements.insight: Following the completed merger in July, Precise Biometrics publishes an information document regarding a rights issue. This capital raise follows the earlier issuance of substitute warrants and EGM resolutions.

announcements.headline: The merger between Precise Biometrics and Fingerprint Cards has been completed
announcements.insight: The merger is now complete following the Swedish Companies Registration Office's permission in July. Shareholders should monitor the substitute warrant issuance outcomes from June and July.

announcements.headline: The Swedish Companies Registration Office has granted permission to implement the merger plan between Precise Biometrics and Fingerprint Cards
announcements.insight: The merger plan is now approved following the July EGM. This final step enables the previously resolved substitute warrant issuance to proceed.

announcements.headline: Report from the Extraordinary General Meeting of Precise Biometrics AB
announcements.insight: The EGM report follows the June issuance of substitute warrants. This confirms the outcome of that corporate action for warrant holders.

announcements.headline: Precise Biometrics announces outcome in the issuance of substitute warrants to holders of warrants in Fingerprint Cards
announcements.insight: Precise Biometrics announces the outcome of substitute warrant issuance following its June resolution. Shareholders should monitor for further details on the terms and implications of this corporate action.

announcements.headline: Precise Biometrics resolves on issuance of substitute warrants in connection with the merger with Fingerprint Cards
announcements.insight: Precise Biometrics resolves on substitute warrants for its merger with Fingerprint Cards. This step advances the combination process, potentially altering capital structure and ownership stakes.

announcements.headline: Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting in Precise Biometrics AB
